body.en:
Question B-006-005-001.

Why the correct answer is right: A standing wave ratio (SWR) of 1:1 means the load impedance matches the transmission line. The meter sees no measurable reflected voltage returning toward the transmitter.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Reflected power equals forward power": Equal reflected and forward power would mean all of the power is being reflected, as with an open or short circuit, which is the opposite of a 1:1 match.
- sourceIndex 2: "An impedance transformer is needed at the antenna feed point": An impedance transformer is a cure for a mismatch at the feed point; a 1:1 SWR already indicates the best match shown by the meter.
- sourceIndex 3: "An antenna tuner is needed at the transmitter": An antenna tuner is used when the transmitter does not see a suitable impedance; at 1:1 the transmitter is already seeing the desired match.
